name: 波普艺术
description: 高饱和纯色、粗网点与轻微套印错位，形成直接鲜活的波普图像力量。
rendering_prompt: Distill the subject into striking flat contours, redistributing light and shade through highly saturated solid colors and strong warm-cool contrast. Add coarse halftone dots and overlapping screen-printed layers in selected areas. Keep boundaries clear, ink grain visible, and registration slightly imperfect. Make the core form distinctly recognizable. Convey vivid popular-image energy through bold color and the tension of a single graphic composition.
avoid: 自动复制四宫格、凭空加文字、照片灰阶
difference: 波普重直接强烈图像冲击；孔版重专色透明叠印
tuning: 保持单幅构图，用不同网点密度组织明暗，保留核心辨识性。
